widths.note: roadway south of the Sixth Street Market House
roadway north of the Sixth Street Market House

notes: West 6th Street between Central and Plum is the wide Sixth Street Market space (about 120' between block faces, north face y=1393, south face y=1810) with the Sixth Street Market House standing in the middle; 40' and 45' are the roadways either side. Central/West 6th is the middle of the four block corners (y=1649) because the north face jumps at Central: the 66' centreline west of Central is y=1698, the market-street centreline east of Central is y=1600. Plum/West 6th uses the full market-street width. The outline at the top right east of Plum (x~2990, y~1610) is the Jabez Elliott building standing in 6th Street, not a block corner. Longworth Street continues west of Central as Carlisle Avenue. Thorpe Alley and Hatters Alley both jog at Plum: west of Plum Thorpe is at y=2088 and east of Plum at y=2157 (69 px); west of Plum Hatters is at y=2888 and east of Plum at y=2816 (72 px); each side is recorded as its own T. Both alleys end at Central (T, no alley west of Central).
